g.text: LOCUS ZERO // FENNOSCANDIAN SHIELD (-3,400 M PRECAMBRIAN)
SPEC-365: 0.00V DC CONSTRAINED DECISION COLLAPSE (CDC) CROWBAR & ZENO-STASIS
Trip on dS/dt < 0 (DRFM Mimic-7 Ghost Rejection)
+5.000V DC OPERATIONAL POWER RAIL (RADAR RF EN)
Crowbar τ < 18ns. Clamps RF rail to 0.00V indefinitely.
Spring breaks Klystron HV on 0.00V drop.
Any out-of-bounds acoustic delay or dS/dt < 0 fires SCR Q1 in < 18ns. V_rail becomes 0.000V DC.
Relay K1 requires continuous holding voltage. Stasis cannot fail open; recovery requires physical manual reset key.
Terminal J3 triggers an optical pulse to append-only WORM disk prior to high-voltage crowbar collapse.
R_DUMP shunts stored inductor/capacitor energy into 3.8°C subterranean glacial river via titanium heat exchanger.
ARCHITECT: ARKITEKTEN FOR DET STILLE PUNKT
